blocks.text: Since its establishment in 1994, Pebsteel has evolved from a pioneer in pre-engineered steel buildings in Vietnam into an international company with a portfolio of more than 6,000 projects across over 50 countries. As the industry continues to evolve, the company is looking beyond expansion to reinforce its competitive position through technology, operational excellence, long-term customer value, and sustainability. Building on 32 years of experience, Pebsteel is preparing for its next chapter of growth.
